basic_info.description:
Open house , Friday and Saturday 8:30 am to 11:30 am.
2 BR/ 1 BA Westwood Park (1,613 sq. ft) detached single family home. Old world craftsmanship, including restored original hardwood floors, moldings, and wainscoting. The home consists of 2 extra large bedrooms (260 and 302 sq. ft.) and a study/office room (8 X 7"10). The Master bedroom includes sun room and dressing area. This beautiful home includes a foyer, formal living room with fireplace and formal dining room, and large kitchen with alderwood cabinets. Plenty of closet and cabinet space. The bathroom includes a jacuzzi tub and separate shower. Interior access to the garage, hobby room, and laundry area. Deck. Interior and exterior newly painted.  Yard will be landscaped as weather permits.

The home is walking distance to Ocean Avenue businesses, services, and MUNI streetcar stop. Find almost everything you would want nearby on Ocean Avenue: Starbucks, Target Express, Whole Foods, Emmy's Restaurant, 24 Hour Fitness and more. Stonestown Galleria, San Francisco State and City College are also nearby. Easy access to public transportation and freeways.

One year lease. Requires first and last month's rent plus $6,150 security deposit. Total move in cost = $14,350. No smoking. Tenant is responsible for all utilities.

Interested party please provide:

Current credit report
Most recent 2 months bank statements
Most recent 2 months pay stubs
Application available upon request

Please call, email or text for an appointment.

Tenant responsible for utilities
